description: This Java class 'ThreadLocalContextUtil' provides utility methods for managing thread-local context information within an application, including tenant info, data source, authentication token, business dates, and action context. It offers initialization and cleanup methods, as well as getters and setters for various thread-specific data.

classes.name: ThreadLocalContextUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing thread-local context information such as tenant, datasource, auth token, business dates, and action context in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the current tenant stored in thread-local storage.

methods.name: setTenant
methods.description: Sets the tenant in thread-local storage.

methods.name: clearTenant
methods.description: Removes the tenant from thread-local storage.

methods.name: getDataSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the data source context string from thread-local storage.

methods.name: setDataSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the data source context string in thread-local storage.

methods.name: clearDataSourceContext
methods.description: Removes the data source context from thread-local storage.

methods.name: getAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from thread-local storage.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token in thread-local storage.

methods.name: getBusinessDates
methods.description: Returns the map of business dates stored in thread-local storage, asserting that it is not null.

methods.name: setBusinessDates
methods.description: Sets the map of business dates in thread-local storage, asserting that it is not null.

methods.name: getBusinessDateByType
methods.description: Returns the business date for a specific BusinessDateType, asserting that it is not null.

methods.name: getBusinessDate
methods.description: Returns the current business date based on the action context's business date type.

methods.name: getActionContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current ActionContext, returning a default if none is set.

methods.name: setActionContext
methods.description: Sets the ActionContext in thread-local storage, asserting that the input is not null.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Constructs a FineractContext object containing the current thread-local context information.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes all thread-local context variables from a given FineractContext object.
